scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw QM not feasible; T0 result-level compare against paper Table 3 electronic variant with tolerance is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for direct exchange energies from Table 3 (electronic variant 'a')
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3, columns a (sum of electronic energies) for HF, SVWN, MPW1PW91 (labelled MPWPW91 in table), and B3PW91 (modified parameters).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published Table 3; cross-checked with the reference solve.sh which hardcodes these values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported results the reproduction target must match within tolerance.

outputs.description: Computed direct exchange energies (high-spin minus singlet) in eV for each dimer and each of the four methods.

output_contract.notes: Only the electronic energy difference (variant without zero-point correction) is scored. The hidden checker compares each value to reference data within a tolerance.
